title: AI Art Deco Generator
summary: Make art deco style images and video with AI: sunbursts, stepped skyscrapers, gold and black glamour. Describe the scene, pick a deco style, and generate.
body_markdown:
### How do I make art deco art with AI?


Describe the subject with its deco motifs, symmetry and palette, such as an ocean liner before a gold sunburst in navy, cream and gold, then pick an art deco style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the still into a clip.


### What colours are used in art deco?


Art deco leans on black, gold and cream, often with one jewel tone such as emerald, jade, navy or burgundy, plus metallic finishes like brass and chrome; posters also used bright coral, orange and blue.


### Can I make an art deco poster with AI?


Yes. Describe one bold central subject, a sunburst or stepped background, flat colour with airbrushed gradients and strict symmetry; generate it without text, then add your own lettering in a design tool, since generated letters often come out wrong.


### Can I make an art deco video?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe the motion, such as searchlights sweeping or the train crossing the viaduct, while asking to keep the flat deco shapes.


### Is the art deco generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
